nodes.description: Immutable address of the logic (implementation) contract used as delegatecall target in the fallback.
Constructor that stores the logic address and performs a delegatecall with the supplied initialization calldata.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls into the stored logic address with raw calldata and returns/reverts with the raw returndata.
Constructor parameter holding the logic contract address that is written to the immutable state variable and used as delegatecall target.
Constructor parameter containing the raw initialization calldata forwarded to the logic contract via delegatecall.
Delegatecall in the constructor to the attacker-supplied logic address with arbitrary initialization calldata; executes foreign code in the proxy's storage context.
Assembly delegatecall in the fallback forwarding untouched calldata to the immutable logic address and bubbling raw returndata.
Local variable in the fallback assigned from the immutable logic state variable and used as the delegatecall target.
Free-memory pointer used for calldatacopy/returndatacopy buffers feeding and receiving the fallback delegatecall.

edges.reason: Constructor consumes the _logic parameter and assigns it to the immutable logic state variable.
The _logic constructor parameter is written into the logic immutable state variable.
The constructor invokes the low-level delegatecall unsafe operation during deployment.
The caller-controlled _logic parameter becomes the target of the constructor delegatecall, allowing arbitrary logic code to be executed at deployment.
The caller-controlled _initializationCalldata parameter is forwarded verbatim into the constructor delegatecall, allowing arbitrary state initialization.
The fallback function body executes the assembly delegatecall unsafe operation.
The immutable logic state variable is read into the _impl local variable in the fallback.
The immutable logic address flows into the fallback delegatecall target.
The _impl local variable is used directly as the delegatecall target in the fallback assembly block.
The ptr free-memory pointer supplies the calldata and returndata buffers for the fallback delegatecall.
The fallback delegatecall executes arbitrary logic code which can call back into the proxy fallback before state is settled, enabling reentrant execution.
Returndata from the fallback delegatecall is copied back through the shared storage context of the logic contract bound to the logic state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The _logic parameter is only a temporary carrier of the delegatecall target address and should be normalized into the constructor delegatecall unsafe operation.
The _initializationCalldata parameter is only a temporary carrier of the calldata forwarded to the constructor delegatecall and should be normalized into that unsafe operation.
The _impl local variable is a direct copy of the logic state variable used solely as the fallback delegatecall target and should be normalized into that unsafe operation.
The ptr local variable only supplies the calldata/returndata buffers for the fallback delegatecall and should be normalized into that unsafe operation.
